correspondent

Possibly Alice Agatha Kekewich (d. 1919), niece of Frances Mary Peard and eldest daughter of Trehawke Kekewich; she married (1886) the Rev.

Charles Ridley Carr (b.1840). [LG 1952 Ellison; 1906 Kekewich]
